title: A Uniform Random-Lattice Tail Bound for the SVP Kissing-Profile Parameter
summary: A recent SICOMP paper on classical and quantum algorithms for the shortest vector problem introduced a lattice-dependent parameter \(γ(L)\), bounded universally in the exponential sense by \(2^{0.402n+o(n)}\), and conjectured that this parameter is \(2^{o(n)}\) for most lattices. We prove the Haar--Siegel random-lattice version in a stronger, dimension-uniform form.
